On The Horizon
Grain Services
Sell. Store. Market. Your Grain, simplified.
The Central United Cooperative grain division offers reliable grain services at 14 convenient locations—Bird Island, Brownton, Buffalo Lake, Cobden, Cologne, Fairfax, Gibbon, Hector, Klossner, Le Sueur, Litchfield, New Ulm, Sleepy Eye, Winthrop— with a combined storage capacity of 46 million bushels in both upright and ground facilities.
View Cash Bids
View Futures
View Weather
What You Can Expect
Competitive Pricing
Market-driven cash bids, futures, and discounts vary by location. We aim to provide you with a competitive price tailored to your logistics and marketing needs.
Grain Services
Services include grain buying, storage, contracting, and direct shipment options to meet your operational pace.
Market Alerts & Live Pricing
Stay informed with timely market alerts, live cash bids, and futures charts—available during Chicago Board of Trade trading hours (8:30 a.m. to 1:15 p.m. weekdays, except holidays)
